meta.simulation_label: SIMULATED under the assumptions listed; not measured operations

assumptions.note: Usable textile capacity of one container. Placeholder; ask the mentor.

assumptions.unit: share of container capacity per week
assumptions.note: Each container's average weekly fill, drawn once per seed from a gamma distribution with this mean and standard deviation (spread). Three profiles because the real rate is unknown; replace with values derived from the sponsor's characterisation if provided.
Week-to-week variation of a container's fill around its own average (gamma, mean 1). Scenario B's planner knows each container's average rate but not this week's random factor.

Scenarios A and B are simulated on the existing textile points plus this many sites proposed by the coverage optimisation (the Coverage tab at +N), each given container_capacity_kg. 0 = existing points only. A planning choice.
Working days available for collection. Each truck can do one route per working day.
Scenario B empties a container if its projected fill would reach T before the next run.
Time to empty one container, including parking. Placeholder; ask the mentor.

Vehicles available for textile collection. Placeholder; ask the mentor. Raised from 1 because one truck could not serve the planned synthetic network at high fill (the simulator refuses to leave stops unserved). Only truck-days actually used are costed, identically for A and B.
Payload per truck. Placeholder; ask the mentor.
Collection-truck speed as a share of OSRM free-flow car speed (travel times are divided by this). Placeholder; check against VITRUS route times.
Working time per truck per collection day. Placeholder; ask the mentor.
Fuel, maintenance and wear per km. Placeholder; ask the mentor.
Combined hourly cost of the whole crew on one truck. Placeholder; ask the mentor.
Fixed cost each day a truck goes out. Placeholder; ask the mentor.
Unknown. Investment is shown as a number of new points until VITRUS gives a unit cost.
Policy choice. A resident counts as covered within this distance of a textile point.

Used only by the fallback (approximate) distance matrix, which is always labelled `approx`. Calibrated in M13 as the median OSRM road / straight-line ratio (IQR 1.33-1.57) over 12,530 pairs >= 300 m apart between the real public points (OSM recycling sites in Guimarães and the assumed depot), on OSM data of 2026-10-18 (Geofabrik Portugal). Recalibrate with `make matrix` when VITRUS's container list arrives.

Average driving speed used only by the fallback (approximate) matrix. Calibrated in M13 as the median OSRM free-flow car speed (45.1 km/h) over the same pairs. Free-flow car speed; a loaded collection truck in town is slower.
Random seeds per scenario; results are reported as min / median / max across seeds.
Simulation horizon set by the challenge (four-week comparison).

coverage.label: Straight-line distance to the nearest textile point (walking proxy)

optimisation_benchmark.label: SIMULATED comparison on identical inputs; nearest-stop is a simple baseline, not the best alternative
